title: Key West Golf Cart Sober Driver Tours
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The main goal is to keep you safe with a SOBER driver. Let us take you on a guided golf cart tour around Key West with a seasoned and sober driver to stay out of trouble! Not only will you likely not know where you're going, but there are rules of the road in Key West for golf carts that folks do not know about and you can end up in trouble / aka: D.U.I. !

So, getting past that, Your pickup point can vary to your wish! We will gladly pick you up and drop you off at your hotel.

Now the fun! We will cruise past Jimmy Buffett's studio, Mallory Square, Sloppy Joe's and Hog's Breath Saloon just to name a few of the great popular party places. Just let us know where you want to go and we will get you there (and back) safely! If you are wanting to party down we can help you get back home without the ticket!
